blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A camera and an IMU are the minimal sensor setup for metric localization and dense mapping, yet classical visual--inertial filters must wait for parallax before they start and then retain only sparse landmarks. Feed-forward geometry models, in contrast, predict dense structure from a few images but provide neither metric scale nor gravity. We present DAVIO, which uses a single multi-view depth model, Depth Anything 3, for both start-up and mapping. At start-up, a five-image window and preintegrated IMU measurements form a feature-free linear system. Its robust, conditioning-checked solution bootstraps a VIO filter through buffered replay. During tracking, the filter’s metric poses condition the depth model. Residual scale is corrected only along viewing rays, which preserves the metric camera baselines, and a gravity-preserving submap graph with drift-gated revisits refines the map. On EuRoC, DAVIO starts markedly earlier, reduces the localization error, and maps more accurately than SOTA feed-forward mappers given identical poses. On building-scale ORI sequences, DAVIO is on bar or better than SOTA mappers on the same odometry, and degrades far less when GT poses are replaced by real odometry. We release the code of DAVIO, a real-time dense metric SLAM system, to the community 1 1 1 https://be2rlab.github.io/DAVIO/ .

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Efficient 3 ​ D 3D perception in autonomous systems heavily relies on combining visual and inertial sensing, as a single camera paired with an IMU provides sufficient information for metric scale recovery and dense reconstruction. However, inertial measurements can resolve metric scale only after sufficient motion separates specific force from gravity [ 1 ] . Once initialized, classical visual–inertial odometry (VIO) [ 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] algorithms maintain tracked sparse landmarks. While sufficient for trajectory estimation, these representations are far too sparse for downstream robotic applications such as autonomous navigation.

blocks.en:
Feed-forward geometry models predict dense point maps or depth directly from co-visible images in a single forward
pass [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 ] .
Trained as foundation models on vast and diverse datasets, they offer strong generalizability and visual robustness. However, their predictions are strictly uncalibrated – lacking metric scale, gravity orientation, sensor velocity, and IMU biases. The two modalities are thus highly complementary: inertial measurements supply the physical quantities missing in learned geometry, while feed-forward models predict dense structure from the initial frames, well before sufficient parallax accumulates for classical initialization [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh:
Feed-forward几何模型从一个单一前方的共可见图像直接预测密集点地图或深度
通过[7,8,9,10,11,12].
它们作为广泛和多样化数据集的基础模型,具有很强的通用性和视觉强健性。 然而,它们的预测严格来说是无法校准的 — — 缺乏度量尺度、重力导向、传感器速度和IMU偏差。 这两种模式因此高度互补:惯性测量提供了所学几何中缺失的物理量,而向导模型则从初始帧中预测密度结构,远在足够准电弧积聚用于古典初始化[13]之前.

blocks.en: To bridge these complementary strengths while addressing their individual limitations, we propose DAVIO , a monocular-inertial system that fuses feed-forward visual geometry with filter-based VIO across two distinct operational phases.
blocks.zh: 为了弥合这些互补的优势,同时解决这些优势的个别局限性,我们提议DAVIO,一种单一的惯性系统,将向导的视觉几何与基于滤波器的VIO连接到两个不同的操作阶段。

blocks.en: During initialization, DAVIO constructs a feature-free state proposal from a five-image window and preintegrated IMU measurements following [ 13 ] (Sec. IV ). This proposal bootstraps an unmodified OpenVINS filter [ 4 ] via a buffered-replay mechanism (Sec. IV-C ). Sensor data arriving during initialization are queued and replayed faster than real time, and the filter publishes only once it has caught up with the live stream, so no measurements are dropped.
blocks.zh: 在初始化过程中,DAVIO通过五象窗口构建一个无特征状态建议,并在[13](第四节)之后进行IMU预集测量. 本提案通过缓冲-重播机制(Sec. IV-C),将未修改的OpenVINS过滤器[4]绑住。 初始化时到达的传感器数据排队和重播速度比实时快,过滤器只在赶上直播流后才会发布,因此没有放弃测量.

blocks.en: During tracking, the interaction reverses: the filter’s metric camera poses condition the geometric foundation model (DA3 [ 12 ] ), yielding overlapping depth submaps (Sec. V-A ). Residual scale corrections are applied only along viewing rays at depth back-projection, thereby preserving the filter’s metric camera baselines (Sec. V-B ). Additionally, a gravity-preserving submap graph jointly refines depth scales and map-frame poses, admitting revisit constraints to the pose problem only after geometric verification and a drift test (Sec. V-C ). The dense map is thus available within seconds of start-up, while the filter state is never modified; the map-frame correction lowers the final trajectory error.
blocks.zh: 在跟踪过程中,交互反向:滤波器的度量相机构成几何基础模型(DA3 [12])的条件,产生重叠的深度子图(Sec. V-A.). 残余尺度的校正只应用在深度反投射的视线上,从而保留了滤波器的度量相机基线(Sec.V-B)。 此外,重力保存子图联合改进了深度尺度和地图框,承认只有在几何验证和漂移试验(Sec.V-C)之后才能重新审视对问题的影响。 因此,密集的地图可以在启动秒内提供,而过滤状态则从未被修改;地图框校正降低了最终的轨迹错误.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: 1. Dual-purpose framework architecture: A real-time unified monocular–inertial system that uses one feed-forward geometry model for both initialization and dense mapping. 2. Robust point–inertial initializer: An extension of the feature-free formulation of [ 13 ] : a stratified, scale-normalized LMedS search with conditioning and physical-plausibility gates, designed to reject unreliable windows rather than pass a wrong scale to the VIO filter. 3. Pose-conditioned mapping formulation: A depth-scaling strategy that applies residual scale corrections only in camera space – preserving intra-window metric baselines – coupled with a submap graph in which relative-scale constraints and gravity-preserving pose updates pass through separate gates.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 1. 双重目的框架结构: 实时统一单体-惯性系统,在初始化和密集映射时使用一个向导几何模型. 2. 强点-惯性初始剂: [13]的无特征配体的扩展:一个分级的,规模化的LMedS搜索,带有条件和物理-可视性门,旨在拒绝不可靠的窗口,而不是向VIO过滤器传递错误的配体. 3. 带政治条件的绘图配制: 深度缩放策略只在相机空间实施剩余尺度校正 — — 保留窗口内度量基准 — — 再加上一个子图,其中相对尺度的制约和重力保持构成的更新通过单独的大门。

blocks.en: Architecture. A tracking process runs filter-based visual–inertial odometry (OpenVINS [ 4 ] ), while a single worker hosts the GPU model (Fig. 2 ). At start-up, five images spaced 0.2 s apart form a geometry window; if its estimate is accepted, it initializes a fresh filter. The OpenVINS initializer remains armed, and whichever filter becomes ready first publishes. During tracking, the worker forms five-frame windows at 0.5 s keyframe spacing, with two images shared between consecutive windows, and commits one map version per window. Each commit defines a rigid correction T M ​ O T_{MO} that is applied to subsequently published poses, whereas velocities, biases, and calibration parameters remain in the filter.

blocks.en: The refined state is propagated to the last image and expressed in a gravity-aligned world frame. It is then written once, with block-wise covariance floors, into a fresh OpenVINS instance through the unmodified initialization entry point. The new instance replays up to 8 s of buffered measurements and is selected once it has produced five consecutive states within 0.15 s of the live stream. blocks.en: The first node fixes the gauge. It starts with λ 0 = 0 \lambda_{0}=0 , and after eviction the first retained node is fixed at its current state. Every other node optimizes translation, yaw about gravity, and λ j \lambda_{j} , so the roll and pitch observed by the filter are preserved. Whenever a scale or point constraint is added, up to eight Levenberg–Marquardt iterations are run. Scale and pose constraints are gated separately: every verified revisit adds its median depth ratio to ℰ s \mathcal{E}_{s} , but its point group enters ℰ p \mathcal{E}_{p} , and can move the poses, only if the odometry drift between the two submaps, predicted by the drift model of W o W_{o} , exceeds the uncertainty of the revisit constraint. blocks.en: Research questions. We ask whether DAVIO (Q1) provides a metric state earlier than the OpenVINS initializer, (Q2) improves the retrospective trajectory, and at what cost to the causal one, and (Q3) improves dense reconstruction under identical inputs. Native is the trajectory of OpenVINS [ 4 ] running alone, with its own initializer and mapping disabled (median of three runs). For a DAVIO run, causal is the published map-frame trajectory, in which each pose uses the latest map correction available at publication time, and final the trajectory re-exported with all corrections after the last graph update.

blocks.en: Data and platform. EuRoC [ 35 ] provides eleven sequences in a Machine Hall (MH) and two Vicon rooms, with OpenVINS reference trajectories, including the corrected V1_01 reference [ 35 ] , and Leica scans of the six Vicon-room sequences. ORI [ 29 ] provides five building-scale sequences (R01–R05) with survey-grade LiDAR references. DAVIO runs on an i7-12700H laptop with an RTX 3060 Laptop GPU (6 GB) and DA3-Base at 504 px, paced at sensor rate on EuRoC and on ORI (with resizing and rectification, as DA3 [ 12 ] operates on undistorted images).

Matched-pose comparisons isolate the mapping layer: ScaRF-SLAM’s released mapper [ 29 ] runs offline on DAVIO’s OpenVINS poses with the same DA3-Base checkpoint. End-to-end comparisons use each system’s own tracker: ORB-SLAM3 [ 5 ] (monocular–inertial, stock EuRoC configuration, three runs), MASt3R-Fusion [ 27 ] (EuRoC monocular–inertial configuration, every second image), and VGGT-SLAM2 [ 22 ] (default parameters, keyframes, and one global Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) fit to the reference, which favors it); the latter two run offline from released code with their own confidence filters, on MH_01, MH_03, MH_05, and ORI.

blocks.en: Metrics. Start-up follows [ 13 ] : 132 ten-second windows per initializer (one start every 10 s; 67 in the Machine Hall, 65 in the Vicon rooms). A window succeeds if a trajectory published within it has an ATE below 0.5 m; T f T_{f} is the sensor time of the first published state (10 s if none), and the quality-penalized time T q T_{q} also charges 10 s to every failure. ATE is the translational RMSE after one rigid alignment without scale [ 36 ] . Coverage is the fraction of the sequence covered by published poses, crediting at most 0.1 s per pose (for baselines, the fraction of frames with a scored pose). Surface metrics score reference points visible from the reference camera path; precision, recall, and F@10 use a 10 cm threshold [ 37 ] . Maps are exported at 2 cm on ORI and 4 cm on EuRoC, with ScaRF’s EuRoC clouds voxelized to match; the released ScaRF chunk evaluator uses 10 m chunks and a 3 cm threshold.

same trajectory in global error and F@10 (0.080 vs. 0.084 m; 0.75 vs. 0.69) at a comparable chunk error (0.044 vs. 0.043 m), while ScaRF attains a higher recall. The end-to-end systems are less accurate: MASt3R-Fusion has 2.4 and 2.8 times DAVIO’s global and chunk errors, and VGGT-SLAM2 reaches an F@10 of only 0.50 despite a global Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) fit (Fig. 3 b).

全球误差和F@10(0.080 vs. 0.084 m;0.75 vs. 0.69)的轨迹相同,其区块误差可比较(0.044 vs. 0.043 m),而ScARF的回溯度较高。 端到端的系统不准确:MAST3R-Fusion拥有2.4倍和2.8倍的DAVIO的全局和块错误,而VGGT-SLAM2尽管有一个全局Sim QQ (3)\mathrm{Sim}(3)适合(图3b),却只达到了F@10的0.50.

blocks.en:
With reference poses, ScaRF’s mapper is more accurate than DAVIO’s offline mapper (0.040 vs. 0.069 m global; 0.029 vs. 0.041 m chunk), whereas DAVIO retains the higher recall. Moving both offline mappers from reference to OpenVINS poses, however, increases DAVIO’s global error by 26 % (0.069 to 0.080 m) but ScaRF’s by 110 % (0.040 to 0.084 m). DAVIO’s advantage on estimated trajectories thus stems from its tolerance to
odometry drift, to which the submap graph contributes: with the graph poses fixed, the error on OpenVINS poses rises to 0.105 m. Finally, DA3-Large lowers DAVIO’s online errors to 0.061 and 0.033 m and raises F@10 to 0.81; in the offline arm on identical fixed OpenVINS poses, it lowers the global error from 0.105 to 0.093 m and raises chunk precision from 62.3 to 73.0 %. Depth quality is therefore a major remaining error source, alongside pose accuracy.

odometry 漂移,亚图图对此有所贡献:随着图形的固定,OpenVINS上的错误会上升至0.105米. 最后,DA3-Large将DAVIO的在线误差降至0.061和0.033米,并将F@10提高到0.81;在同样固定的OpenVINS的离线臂上,它将全局误差从0.105米降至0.093米,将块精度从62.3提高到73.0%. 因此,深度质量是尚存的一个主要错误源,同时也具有准确性。

blocks.en: VIII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 八 结论

blocks.en: DAVIO uses one feed-forward geometry model to start a classical VIO filter early and to build dense metric maps conditioned on its poses. It shortens Machine Hall start-up, lowers the final trajectory error, maps with lower error than ScaRF-SLAM’s released mapper on identical EuRoC poses, and outperforms MASt3R-Fusion and VGGT-SLAM2 in EuRoC trajectory accuracy and ORI surface error.
blocks.zh: DAVIO使用一个向前进的几何模型提前开始一个古典VIO滤波器,并构建以它的姿势为条件的密集的测量图. 它缩短了机器大厅的启动,降低了最终的轨迹误差,比ScARF-SLAM在相同的EuroC上发布的映射器错误更小的地图,并且优于EuroC轨迹精度和ORI表面误差中的MAST3R-Fusion和VGGT-SLAM2.
